Additionally, adherence to common coding styles and standards is emphasized to ensure code quality and maintainability.

It features automatic updates to core configuration settings, ensuring accurate configurations for web and other settings, and provides user-friendly access through the Admin interface.

The module automatically updates values in core_config_data for accurate web configurations.
